title: fix(runtime)!: the dispatcher's GET /data/:object/:id refuses an unknown query parameter as RestServer does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XF3QFJAFuZhRRxEVZmmSGCV)_

Fixes #26898

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` (the by-id read's parameter sentence said "all other parameters are discarded"); no `skills/**` file teaches this route's query set

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:运行时 dispatcher 的 `GET /data/:object/:id` 遇到 `select` / `expand` 以外的查询参数,改为 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` 拒绝,与 RestServer 同状态、同 code、同一句文案;两边读同一个参数集 `DATA_RECORD_READ_PARAMS`(由 `@objectstack/rest` 导出)。
- **为什么改**:同一个拼错的参数(`?selct=name`)在 RestServer 上被拒,在 dispatcher 上被静默丢掉并返回全部列,客户端得不到任何提示。
- **风险与回滚**:原先被容忍的多余参数现在会 400(只影响 dispatcher 承载的按 id 读取);官方 SDK 的 `data.get` 不带查询参数,不受影响。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts`(按 id 读取分支的新拒绝与门序)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/data-record-read-status-parity.test.ts`(两宿主对拍)、`packages/rest/src/index.ts`(新增的一个导出)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/data-record-read-status-parity.test.ts`,预期 19/19 通过,其中 `?nope=1` 各例两宿主都是 400。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The dispatcher's by-id read asks the route's closed set.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts`: after the object's API exposure gate (`refuseUnexposedDataAction(..., 'get', ...)`, where `RestServer` asks `enforceApiAccess`), the branch asks `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage(query, DATA_RECORD_READ_PARAMS)` and answers any name outside `select` / `expand` `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` in the dispatcher's envelope, the same sentence `RestServer`'s `refuseUnknownQueryParams` writes. It used to drop those names and serve the read (`200`). The refusal comes before the read, so it is one answer for an existing record, a missing id and a row the caller may not read.
- **Where the one set lives, and why.** `DATA_RECORD_READ_PARAMS` stays where it was declared (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, #7606 / #8039 docblock) and `@objectstack/rest` now exports it from its entry. `@objectstack/runtime` already depends on `@objectstack/rest` (`packages/runtime/package.json`) and `data.ts` already imports two `/data` rules from it (`assertFilterParamSuppliedOnce`, `repeatedQueryParamMessage`); `@objectstack/rest` does not depend on `@objectstack/runtime`. So no new dependency edge and no cycle. `packages/spec/**` is untouched. The precedent is #23072 (`metaItemQueryRefusal`) and #26020 (`unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage`): a closed-set decision `RestServer` owns, exported for the dispatcher's twin.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` said the by-id read discards other parameters; it now says they are refused, naming them.
- **Changeset.** `patch` on `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/rest`, `fix(runtime)!:`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

**Clause-② measured on the diff.** The claim carried `no (narrowing)` as likely. The diff narrows one door's accept set (the `(narrowing)` arm) and also adds one name to `@objectstack/rest`'s entry, which the criterion counts as a wider public surface ("本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗", `references/execution-duties.md`). So the measured line is `yes (narrowing)`, the line #23072's PR (8024e12) declared for the same shape. If the seat reads a re-exported constant as not widening the surface, the line becomes `no (narrowing)` and nothing else changes.

## Tests

- **Red first, on the base `57820085fa`** (test commit only, `data.ts` at base): `data-record-read-status-parity.test.ts` 6 failed / 13 passed. Every failure was the dispatcher assertion: `?nope=1`, `?select=title&nope=1`, `?fields=title`, `?nope=1&selct=title` on the own record answered `200`; `?nope=1` on the hidden row and the missing id answered `404`. `RestServer` answered all six `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`.
- **Green after the fix**: 19 / 19. Both hosts answer the six cases `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with the same sentence. Controls kept on both hosts: `?select=title` and `?expand=parent` on the own record `200`, a missing id `404`, a hidden row `404`, a hidden row `?select=title` `404`, the #26816 `400` cases unchanged.
- **Gate order, dispatcher pin**: `?nope=1` on an object with `apiEnabled: false` answers `404 OBJECT_API_DISABLED`, the same answer as without the parameter. Pinned on the dispatcher alone: this rig's `RestServer` has no metadata store, so its exposure gate falls open there (measured: a plain read of that object answered `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`) and would not measure the order. `RestServer`'s order is `enforceApiAccess` before `refuseUnknownQueryParams` in `crud-routes.ts`.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `if (unknownParams !== undefined)` → `if (false && ...)`, blob `a351a771` → `992a9a63`): the six card cases red, 13 passed; restored, blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The test reaches `data.ts` through a relative source import, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
- **Package suites** (under the verify lock): `@objectstack/runtime` test 1 failed / 462 files on the first run: `http-dispatcher.test.ts` pinned the old drop ("should NOT pass non-allowlisted params"). That pin now asserts the refusal (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the sentence naming `filter` and `malicious`, `getData` not asked): `http-dispatcher.test.ts` 248 / 248. `@objectstack/runtime` typecheck 0, `@objectstack/rest` test 329 / 329 files (6525 passed), typecheck 0.
- **Lint** on the touched files: `eslint --no-inline-config` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The dispatcher's other `/data` routes** (`route-ledger.ts` rows), each against its `RestServer` twin. None has a declared closed set on the `RestServer` side, so none is fixed here.
  - `GET /data/:object` (list): open by design on both hosts; a leftover key is an implicit field filter and an unknown field is refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` one layer down (`query-allowlist.ts` "do not add this gate").
  - `POST /data/:object/query`, `POST /data/:object`, `PATCH /data/:object/:id`: neither host reads the querystring; an unknown parameter is ignored on both. No split.
  - `DELETE /data/:object/:id`: both read `expectedVersion` (once, arity-gated on both) and ignore every other name. No split.
  - Closing those four would be a new closed set on both hosts at once, a #7606-policy question, not this card's parity defect.
- **An observation, not filed.** A host whose `/data` is answered by the dispatcher alone (no `RestServer`) has no `GET /data/:object/export` route, so that path reaches the by-id branch with id `export`. It answered `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` before; with `?format=csv` it now answers this route's `400` naming `format`. Both are refusals of a route that host does not serve; not measured on a live host.
- **The wire carries no `param` key** on either host for this refusal: `RestServer` writes `{ error: { code, message } }`, the dispatcher `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`. The refused names are in the sentence, identical on both (the rig asserts the messages equal).

## Verification

All on the final head `f5f4f537`.
